description: This Java class 'SecurityController' is a Spring MVC controller handling security-related admin endpoints, such as displaying permissions and user groups. It interacts with 'GroupService' and manages web requests mapped to specific URLs, preparing models and views for the admin UI.

classes.name: SecurityController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing admin security endpoints, including permissions and user groups.

methods.name: displayPermissions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show permissions page, sets menu context for the view.

methods.name: displayGroups
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show user groups, retrieves group list via GroupService and adds it to the model.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set active menu context and current menu item in the model for UI rendering.
